scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker "pnpm --filter @future-flow/web dev" "pnpm --filter @future-flow/api dev" "pnpm --filter @future-flow/worker dev"
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @future-flow/contracts build && pnpm --filter @future-flow/core build && pnpm --filter @future-flow/database build && pnpm --filter @future-flow/ai build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @future-flow/api build && pnpm --filter @future-flow/worker build && pnpm --filter @future-flow/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.smoke:auth: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @future-flow/api build && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.scripts.json --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/smoke-authenticated-life.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests deploy "*.json" "*.ts" "*.yaml" .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests deploy "*.json" "*.ts" "*.yaml" .github
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
